sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS)
by the petitioner/accused No.1, seeking anticipatory bail, in connection with Crime No.325 of 2025 of Gachibowli Police Station, Cyberabad Commissionarate, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 379, 468, 506 read with 34 of Indian Penal Code (for short 'IPC').
2. Heard Sri Lattupally Anand, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Syed Yasar Mamoon,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent-State.
3.

It is the case of the prosecution that K.Vasantha has lodged a complaint before the Gachibowli Police Station on 25.02.2025 stating that G.Mahalaxmi, K.N.Somayajulu, R.Ramana Murthy and Atiq have cheated her husband by making forgery signature and theft of property documents,
criminal conspiracy, criminal intimidation and trespass and threatened her with dire consequences.

Basing on the same, Gachibowli Police registered a case vide Cr.No.325 of 2025 dated 25.02.2025 for offences punishable under Sections 420, 379, 468, 506 read with 34 of IPC.
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the offences registered against petitioner/A1 are below seven years.

Without going into the merits, as the offences alleged against the petitioner are punishable below seven years and in view of the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1, the Investigating Officer is directed to serve notice under Section 35 (3) of BNSS to the petitioner.

sentences.text: 6. It is made clear that the petitioner/accused No.1 shall cooperate with the Investigating Officer for the investigation and she shall make herself available as and when they called for by the Investigating Officer.
If the petitioner/accused No.1 failed to cooperate with the Investigating Officer for investigation, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to take action against her according to law.
7. With the above observations, this Criminal Petition is disposed of.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, stand closed.

The Hon'Ble Justice B.R.Madhusudhan Rao
Criminal Petition No.6753 of 2025
Order:
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS)
by the petitioner/accused No.1, seeking anticipatory bail, in connection with Crime No.325 of 2025 of Gachibowli Police Station, Cyberabad Commissionarate, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 379, 468, 506 read with 34 of Indian Penal Code (for short 'IPC').
2. Heard Sri Lattupally Anand, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Syed Yasar Mamoon,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent-State.
3.
It is the case of the prosecution that K.Vasantha has lodged a complaint before the Gachibowli Police Station on 25.02.2025 stating that G.Mahalaxmi, K.N.Somayajulu, R.Ramana Murthy and Atiq have cheated her husband by making forgery signature and theft of property documents,
criminal conspiracy, criminal intimidation and trespass and threatened her with dire consequences.
Basing on the same, Gachibowli Police registered a case vide Cr.No.325 of 2025 dated 25.02.2025 for offences punishable under Sections 420, 379, 468, 506 read with 34 of IPC.
4.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Without going into the merits, as the offences alleged against the petitioner are punishable below seven years and in view of the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1, the Investigating Officer is directed to serve notice under Section 35 (3) of BNSS to the petitioner.
6. It is made clear that the petitioner/accused No.1 shall cooperate with the Investigating Officer for the investigation and she shall make herself available as and when they called for by the Investigating Officer.
If the petitioner/accused No.1 failed to cooperate with the Investigating Officer for investigation, the Investigating Officer is at liberty to take action against her according to law.
7. With the above observations, this Criminal Petition is disposed of.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, stand closed.
